rules.description: You must have been married for over a year
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot apply for a divorce until you have been married for at least one year. You may be able to apply for separation or annulment.

rules.description: Your relationship must have permanently broken down
rules.reason_if_failed: You must confirm that your relationship has permanently broken down to apply for a divorce

rules.description: Your marriage must be legally recognised in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: Your marriage must be legally recognised in the UK (including same-sex marriage)

rules.description: You must be applying in England or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for divorces in England and Wales only. There are different processes for Scotland and Northern Ireland.

rules.description: This service is for ending marriages, not civil partnerships
rules.reason_if_failed: If you are ending a civil partnership, use the service for ending a civil partnership.

explanation_template: Divorce application eligibility: {outcome}. Minimum timeframe: 26 weeks (20 weeks to Conditional Order + 6 weeks to Final Order).

edge_cases.description: Applicant is at risk of domestic abuse from spouse
edge_cases.action: Joint application not recommended. Route to sole application pathway and provide domestic abuse support resources.

edge_cases.description: Spouse does not respond to court papers within 14 days
edge_cases.action: Applicant can continue as sole applicant. Court will contact applicant with next steps.

edge_cases.description: Spouse intends to dispute the divorce
edge_cases.action: Spouse must complete answer form with genuine legal reason. May require court hearing. Human case worker required.

edge_cases.description: Spouse lacks mental capacity to consent or participate
edge_cases.action: Requires appointment of litigation friend. Contact Official Solicitor if no suitable person available. Human caseworker required.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is married to more than one person
edge_cases.action: Contact Divorce Service Centre for special handling. Standard online process cannot be used.

edge_cases.description: Applicant does not know spouse's current address
edge_cases.action: Special process required for service of papers. Court can advise on alternative methods of service.

edge_cases.description: Applicant needs legally binding financial/property arrangements
edge_cases.action: Must apply to court for consent order BEFORE applying for final order. Divorce cannot be finalized until resolved.
